capabilities: Display a dual-column dashboard with an interactive calendar and a timeline of note footprints
Render a traditional Chinese almanac with heavenly-stem and earthly-branch dating
Extract dates from note filenames when metadata is missing
Provide a frosted-glass quick capture dialog for jotting ideas
Force serif/Songti typography across the dashboard
disambiguation: Not a time-tracking or Pomodoro tool; it is a calendar-style dashboard start page.
extras: Explicitly warns phone users not to install this version and points them to a separate Mobile Dashboard release. Installation is primarily via BRAT (beta plugin) or manual file placement. The author accepts donations via WeChat/Alipay and runs a feedback community on Xiaohongshu.
problem: Obsidian opens on a blank startup screen with no date-oriented overview, and file creation dates can be lost when notes are synced across devices via iCloud or other drives.
summary: A widescreen dashboard start page with a dual-column calendar and timeline layout, Chinese almanac (Bazi) axis, filename-based date parsing, and quick capture.
